en.hubeali: Ahmad Bin Idrees, from Muhammad Bin Abdul Jabbar, from one of our companions, (It has been narrated) raising it to Abu Abdullahasws, said, ‘I said to himasws, ‘What is the ‘الْعَقْلَ’ (Aql- intellect?’ Heasws said: ‘Through which the Beneficent is worshipped with, and the Gardens are attained with’.
I said, ‘So that which was in Muawiya?’ So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘That is the heinous, that is the devilry, and it may disguise as the intellect, but it is not the intellect’.
